dd_ac_bonus_1.name: AC Bonus +1
dd_ac_bonus_1.description: Gain a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class (+2 at 4th, +3 at 7th, +4 at 10th level).

defensive_stance_1.name: Defensive Stance
defensive_stance_1.description: Become a bastion of defense (+2 STR, +4 CON, +2 resistance bonus on all saves, +4 dodge bonus to AC while stationary).

mobile_defense.name: Mobile Defense
mobile_defense.description: Take one 5-foot step each round while in a defensive stance without losing the benefit of the stance.

uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncanny_dodge.description: Retain Dexterity bonus to AC even if caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker.

defensive_stance_2.name: Defensive Stance (2/day)
defensive_stance_2.description: Enter a rooted defensive stance twice per day.

dd_ac_bonus_2.name: AC Bonus (+2)
dd_ac_bonus_2.description: Dwarven Defender dodge bonus to AC increases to +2.

trap_sense_1.name: Trap Sense +1
trap_sense_1.description: Gain +1 bonus on Reflex saves and +1 dodge bonus to AC against traps.

defensive_stance_3.name: Defensive Stance (3/day)
defensive_stance_3.description: Enter a rooted defensive stance three times per day.

damage_reduction_3.name: Damage Reduction 3/-
damage_reduction_3.description: Subtract 3 from damage dealt by weapons and natural attacks.

improved_uncanny_dodge.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
improved_uncanny_dodge.description: Can no longer be flanked; rogues must be at least 4 levels higher to sneak attack via flanking.

dd_ac_bonus_3.name: AC Bonus (+3)
dd_ac_bonus_3.description: Dwarven Defender dodge bonus to AC increases to +3.

defensive_stance_4.name: Defensive Stance (4/day)
defensive_stance_4.description: Enter a rooted defensive stance four times per day.

trap_sense_2.name: Trap Sense +2
trap_sense_2.description: Gain +2 bonus on Reflex saves and +2 dodge bonus to AC against traps.

defensive_stance_5.name: Defensive Stance (5/day)
defensive_stance_5.description: Enter a rooted defensive stance five times per day.

damage_reduction_6.name: Damage Reduction 6/-
damage_reduction_6.description: Subtract 6 from damage dealt by weapons and natural attacks.

dd_ac_bonus_4.name: AC Bonus (+4)
dd_ac_bonus_4.description: Dwarven Defender dodge bonus to AC increases to +4.
